originalText:
Love.

Man becomes a slave because he is afraid to be alone,
so he needs a crowd, a society, an organization.

Fear is the basis of all institutions, and how can a
frightened mind know the truth?
Truth requires fearlessness and fearlessness comes from
sadhana, not from societies.
That is why all religions, institutions and organization
bar the path of truth.
